sections.content: Natural advice can combine obligation, direct recommendations, conditional suggestions and the subjunctive. Choose the structure according to how direct the advice should sound and explain the likely consequence.

items.spanish: Si yo fuera tú, pediría ayuda porque el problema podría ser más serio de lo que parece.
items.english: If I were you, I would ask for help because the problem could be more serious than it seems.

items.spanish: Te recomiendo que revises el plan antes de aplicarlo, aunque tengas poco tiempo.
items.english: I recommend that you review the plan before putting it into practice, even if you have little time.

items.spanish: Deberías considerar otra alternativa para que el resultado sea más seguro.
items.english: You should consider another alternative so that the outcome is safer.

items.spanish: Tienes que actuar con precaución; de lo contrario, podrías asumir un riesgo innecesario.
items.english: You have to act cautiously; otherwise, you could take an unnecessary risk.

sections.content: Integrated advice is about meaning, not memorising one formula. Consider whether you are giving an obligation, a direct recommendation, a hypothetical suggestion or a reasoned consequence.
